title: [main] Upgrade important CI environment
body: This PR upgrades important dependencies of the CI environment.

files.patch:
@@ -471,7 +471,7 @@ repos:
         types_or: [python, pyi]
         args: [--fix]
         require_serial: true
-        additional_dependencies: ['ruff==0.15.11']
+        additional_dependencies: ['ruff==0.15.12']
         exclude: ^airflow-core/tests/unit/dags/test_imports\.py$|^performance/tests/test_.*\.py$
       - id: ruff-format
         name: Run 'ruff format'
